authentication_notes: /sessions POST is the only unauthenticated endpoint; all other endpoints require valid session from createSession or are public read-only (listApprovedReports, createUploadUrl).
/citizens/verify-email depends on prior creation of verification code via /citizens/verification-code.
/admin/* and /reports/* operations require elevated roles (admin, technical officer, maintainer) as implied by 403 responses.
Operations marked auth_required need an authenticated session during test setup.
dependencies: /sessions POST is prerequisite for all auth-required endpoints. /registration POST allows new citizen accounts without prior login. /citizens/verification-code must precede /citizens/verify-email. Admin operations (/admin/*) depend on user creation via /admin/createuser. Report operations (/reports/*) depend on report creation via /reports POST.
Chat and notification endpoints depend on existing reports or sessions.
POST /reports -> GET /chats/{reportId}: A report must exist before an operation can address reportId.
POST /reports -> POST /chats/{reportId}/read: A report must exist before an operation can address reportId.
POST /sessions -> GET /sessions/current: getCurrentSession requires an active session created by createSession.
POST /citizens/verification-code -> POST /citizens/verify-email: verifyCitizenEmail requires an active verification code generated by createCitizenVerificationCode.
POST /admin/createuser -> POST /admin/addcategory: addOperatorCategory requires an existing operator created by createMunicipalityUser.
POST /reports -> PUT /reports/{id}/status: updateReportStatus requires an existing report created by createReport.
POST /reports -> PUT /reports/{id}/operator: assignReportOperator requires an existing report created by createReport.

risks: /citizens/verify-email may fail if verification code expires (423) without explicit expiry handling in client. /admin/* endpoints lack explicit role checks in documentation; 403 responses imply hidden role requirements. Route name 'mainteiner' is non-standard and may cause confusion or typos in client implementations.
listApprovedReports is public but depends on report creation flow; no clear mechanism to filter by category or status beyond 'approved'.
Notification and chat endpoints rely on session state that may be invalidated by deleteCurrentSession without explicit cleanup guidance.
